envelope.description: Build the static ConfigKeyMap (native-key <-> catalog-path <-> ConfigOption)

body.title: Build the static ConfigKeyMap (native-key <-> catalog-path <-> ConfigOption)
body.summary: Add a pure, VS-Code-free module that derives, from the imported global CONFIG_CATALOG, a static bidirectional table pairing each native key (`insrc.<path>`) with its catalog path and its ConfigOption (type + enumValues for validation). This is the single source sc8's pull/apply lookups and the manifest<->catalog contract test both read. Private to the sc8 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: a VS-Code-free module exports a ConfigKeyMap covering all 31 global CONFIG_CATALOG options with native key, catalog path, and ConfigOption
the module imports CONFIG_CATALOG from the daemon config-catalog source and imports no 'vscode'
lookups are 1:1 and total over the global options (nativeKey->option and path->option both resolve)

tests.name: ConfigKeyMap covers all 31 global options and resolves both nativeKey->option and path->option 1:1
